lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Welcome to the ruins. Use WASD to move and Space to jump.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Note: Momentum is key. Long jumps require a running start.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: Tutorial Started: Reach the upper ledge.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Halt! The ruins ahead are unstable.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: You'll need more than just luck to survive the storm.
